Brittney Sykes leads the Toronto Tempo (3-2) into a matchup with the Minnesota Lynx (2-2) after scoring 31 points in a 98-90 win over the Mercury. The matchup is on Thursday, May 21, 2026, tipping off at 8 p.m. ET on Victory+ and TSN.
Lynx vs. Tempo Prediction & Odds Favorite: Lynx (-6.5) Total: 172.5 Lynx Moneyline: -282 Tempo Moneyline: +223 Spread Prediction: Lynx Total Prediction: Over Moneyline Prediction: Lynx Lynx Players to Watch (2025 stats) Courtney Williams put up 13.6 points per game last season to go with 6.2 assists. Natasha Howard grabbed 6.6 rebounds per game while also scoring 11.4 points a contest. Kayla McBride hit an average of 2.6 shots per game from beyond the arc a season ago. Williams and Maria Alekseyevna Kliundikova were defensive standouts last season, with Williams averaging 1.3 steals per game and Kliundikova collecting 0.8 blocks per contest. Tempo Players to Watch (2025 stats) The Tempo’s go-to player, Sykes, leads the team in both scoring (25.6 points per game) and assists (4.8 assists per game). Nyara Sabally’s 6.0 rebounds per game paces Toronto’s rebounding effort. She also adds 9.3 points per game. Marina Mabrey is tops from three-point range for the Tempo, knocking down 3.6 threes per game.
